tone-pulse.title: Tone and Pulse as different interpretive layers
tone-pulse.meaning_summary: Astronomical sign supplies Tone; same-element decan supplies Pulse and refines the manner of expression.
exceptions: Mercury and Venus decan ruler names alone can lose the sign/element distinction.
tone-pulse.report_gap: Tone/Pulse labels calculate correctly; their meaning and interaction are not assembled into reports.

spark-entry.title: Spark as an entry to expression
spark-entry.meaning_summary: The degree is described as an initial motive or activation entry, beyond the decan; the parity procedure and examples disagree.
exceptions: Keep house and sign candidates separate.
Composite Saturn Libra 28/H2 is labelled Pisces and matches neither candidate.
spark-entry.report_gap: No canonical Spark can support a precise profile entry-point statement.

delegate-condition.title: Bidirectional rulership and full Delegate condition
delegate-condition.meaning_summary: A ruler carries both the sign themes and the condition of the occupants of its ruled sign, including their relationships, into its placement.
exceptions: Do not follow natural inner-wheel rulership as if it were outer-wheel rulership.
Do not crown an arbitrary final dispositor or discard cycles.
delegate-condition.report_gap: Modern sign-ruler lookup is present; there is no typed Delegate graph carrying house and occupant condition.

retrograde-meaning.title: Natal retrograde imprint and reworking
retrograde-meaning.meaning_summary: Retrograde themes turn inward and require revision; the source distinguishes a natal imprint from a temporary transit pressure.
exceptions: Do not assert an individual childhood event solely from this source description.
Do not impose the book's always-retrograde node claim on true-node physical speed.
retrograde-meaning.report_gap: Speed and supported Gradity phases exist, but no body-specific natal/transit interpretation is used.

retrograded-house.title: Retrograded house through its Delegate
retrograded-house.meaning_summary: A retrograde sign ruler modifies the life-area energy as it carries it elsewhere; the occupied house does not acquire physical retrograde motion.
exceptions: An Rx occupant does not retrograde every occupant or its entire house.
Aries Rising has neither H4 nor H5 ruler Rx; Taurus cannot have H4 Rx; Pisces cannot have H5 Rx under the given modern ruler scheme.
retrograded-house.report_gap: No separate house/Delegate motion semantics or template exceptions.

directional-context.title: Directional relationships require both contexts
directional-context.meaning_summary: Retain sender, receiver, geometric order, Vantage, OOI and ecosystem; the receiving planet's house, ruler and relationships matter.
exceptions: A symmetric angular separation is not a source-approved directed relationship.
Do not sum two OOIs across people or transit/natal ecosystems.
directional-context.report_gap: There is no full directional aspect graph or target-condition resolver.

natal-transit-order.title: Natal and external-transit reading order
natal-transit-order.meaning_summary: Natal is a fixed internal blueprint; transits pressure from an external ecosystem and require distinct direction/order handling.
exceptions: A natal applying imprint is not a lifetime timer of increasing pressure.
Do not assume transit-to-natal and natal-to-transit have identical meanings.
natal-transit-order.report_gap: Only a natal calculation request is implemented; no chart-context relationship planner.

age-degree.title: Age-degree meaning and retrograde delays
age-degree.meaning_summary: Degree-linked ages are distinguished from transits, progression and house profections; delayed retrograde anecdotes complicate precise timing.
exceptions: Do not turn the Ava medical anecdote into a validated prediction method.
No fractional-year/calendar conversion or retrograde delay formula is supplied.
age-degree.report_gap: Integer age-label helper is not an event-date algorithm or prediction.
